items.title: Abbott to spin off its global Nutrition business as an independent listed company
items.summary: Abbott plans a tax-free spin-off of Nutrition (Ensure, Glucerna, PediaSure, Pedialyte, Similac): about $8.5bn sales, 16,000 staff, 14 plants. CEO-designate Daniel Salvadori. Abbott keeps devices, Libre, diagnostics and established medicines (about $42bn).

items.title: Medtronic completes separation of MiniMed; diabetes business now independent on Nasdaq (MMED)
items.summary: Medtronic exchanged its entire remaining MiniMed stake (252,813,348 shares) through an exchange offer 5.4 times oversubscribed, so MiniMed is now fully independent and trades as MMED on Nasdaq. Medtronic no longer holds equity in it.

items.title: WHO urges healthcare professionals to prioritise early diagnosis and equitable care this World Diabetes Day
items.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) is calling on healthcare professionals to strengthen early diabetes detection, improve access to quality treatment and tackle stigma as part of its World Diabetes Day 2026 campaign.

items.title: Weight-loss surgery linked to long-term type 2 diabetes remission, 14-year study finds
items.summary: People with type 2 diabetes who undergo weight-loss surgery are significantly more likely to achieve remission than those receiving medication and lifestyle treatment alone, according to new research published in Diabetes Care.

items.title: Final free quality improvement programme launched to improve care for young adults with type 2 diabetes
items.summary: Healthcare professionals are being encouraged to register for a free introductory webinar this November as part of the final phase of a national quality improvement programme aimed at improving outcomes for young adults with type 2 diabetes.

items.title: X-PERT Health joins Spirit Health to strengthen diabetes education across the UK
items.summary: Established provider of structured diabetes education X-PERT Health has joined Spirit Health Group. The move brings X-PERT alongside Spirit’s EMPOWER programme, with both continuing to offer people living with diabetes practical support to manage their health and live well.

items.title: UK delegation learns about Korean diabetes care
items.summary: A team of healthcare professionals from the UK gained a “unique insight” about diabetes care in South Korea as part of Spirit Health’s new knowledge exchange programme.

items.title: Too many children reaching ‘crisis point’ before type 1 diabetes is recognised
items.summary: Hundreds of babies and young children are becoming seriously ill each year before their type 1 diabetes is diagnosed, a leading charity has warned.

items.title: The Kar Report: PDEL, Oh no…more acronyms. Or is it?
items.summary: So, once again, it’s all change in the NHS. Amidst all the acronyms, one cannot miss the return of SHA – previously Strategic Health Authorities – which will undoubtedly raise a smile among those who have lived through previous NHS reorganisations.

items.title: Beano-inspired classroom resources aim to improve type 1 diabetes awareness among children and teachers
items.summary: Healthcare professionals are being encouraged to raise awareness of free educational resources designed to improve the understanding of type 1 diabetes (T1D) in primary schools, following a collaboration between Sanofi UK, DigiBete and Beano for Schools.

items.title: New AI-driven device for predicting overnight hypoglycaemia available for first time on NHS for people with diabetes in Devon
items.summary: People living with diabetes across Devon can now access a new AI-powered continuous glucose monitor (CGM) through the NHS for the first time, as a new campaign launches in the region to highlight the impact of the condition on everyday life.

items.title: Free Diabetes UK webinar series to inspire better diabetes care this winter
items.summary: Healthcare professionals are being invited to join a free winter webinar series from Diabetes UK, bringing together expert knowledge, real-world experiences and practical ideas to help improve diabetes care and outcomes.

items.title: The Big Interview: Joy Allen on how AI-powered technology is transforming diabetes management
items.summary: Watch now: How can AI-powered technology transform diabetes management and give people greater confidence to live life on their terms? Diabetes Times Editor Oliver Jelley speaks with Joy Allen, Head of Market Access and Public Affairs at Roche Diagnostics, for the latest Big Interview.

items.title: First UK patient receives teplizumab on NHS to delay type 1 diabetes
items.summary: A woman from Shropshire has become the first patient in the UK to receive teplizumab through routine NHS care, following the approval of the groundbreaking treatment to delay the progression of type 1 diabetes.

items.title: Obesity & Weight Management Alliance expands 2027 conference programme across UK and Ireland
items.summary: The Obesity & Weight Management Alliance anticipate that they will receive sponsorship from pharmaceutical companies and MedTech organisations for the 2027 conferences. As soon as sponsorship is confirmed, the details will be added to the website and all promotional materials where appropriate.

items.title: Free webinar to explore diagnosis and management of diabetic autonomic neuropathy
items.summary: Leading international experts will discuss the diagnosis, screening and treatment of cardiovascular autonomic neuropathy and diabetic gastroenteropathy during a free educational webinar this November.

items.title: Better training in new diabetes tech needed for community nurses
items.summary: Community nurses and other non-specialist staff need more training to provide support to patients with diabetes using modern insulin-management systems, a new report has found.

items.title: GPs ‘should monitor diabetes risk’ in months after starting patients on antipsychotics
items.summary: Significant metabolic changes are seen in the first 90 days of use of antipsychotic medications, say researchers who recommend closer monitoring at the start.

items.title: Effect of topical insulin in diabetic foot ulcer healing among patients with diabetes in Asia: a systematic review
items.summary:
Objective:
The aim of this systematic review is to provide a comprehensive understanding on the effectiveness of topical insulin in the healing of diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) in patients with diabetes in Asian countries.


Method:
A systematic review of both observational and randomised controlled…

items.title: US FDA 510(k) — Safe AQ Easy Blood Glucose Monitoring System; Safe AQ Care Blood Glucose Monitoring System
Insulin: types, actions and principles of safe administration
items.summary: Understanding insulin action, types and factors influencing insulin use is essential for delivering safe, effective patient-centred care.

items.title: Empowering people through diet and lifestyle in type 2 diabetes management
items.summary: Dietary change, physical activity, weight management and self-management education are fundamental components of type 2 diabetes care.

items.title: Award: Insulin Pumps
items.summary: CAMBRIDGE UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS NHS FOUNDATION TRUST. 1790 - Insulin Pumps and consumables .

items.title: Healthcare professionals unite to champion joined up care at inaugural CVRM Professional Care
items.summary: Healthcare professionals from across the UK came together at the inaugural CVRM Professional Care to explore how greater collaboration between specialities could transform care for people living with multiple long-term conditions.

items.title: Alzheimer’s trial launches to test diabetes and ADHD drugs
items.summary: A large UK study has been launched to test several drugs for Alzheimer’s disease that are already being used for other conditions. The multi-arm adaptive randomised controlled trial being run across 30 NHS sites when fully operational will initially test metformin and atomoxetine with results expected by 2030.

items.title: Same needle, new name and packaging as embecta updates insulin pen needle portfolio
items.summary: Healthcare professionals are being reminded that insulin pen needles previously branded BD are now available under new embecta product names and packaging, with the needles themselves remaining unchanged.

items.title: Registration opens for Diabetes UK Professional Conference 2027 in Liverpool
items.summary: This event is sponsored by industry, including pharmaceutical companies. [View sponsor list] Diabetes UK independently develops the programme; sponsors have no influence over the content of speakers, aside from clearly-identified sponsor sessions.

items.title: “One size does not fit all” – GP calls for personalised care for patients with multiple long-term conditions
items.summary: Patients with multiple long-term conditions must be put “in the driver’s seat” when making decisions about their treatment, a cardiovascular, renal and metabolic (CVRM) specialist told delegates at CVRM Professional Care 2026 today (October 21).

items.title: Hospital admissions for complex CVRM conditions represent a ‘failure of our systems’, says NHS England clinical director
items.summary: Patients developing complex cardiovascular, renal and metabolic (CVRM) conditions that require hospital treatment represent a “failure of our systems upstream”, a consultant pharmacist and NHS England clinical director told delegates at CVRM Professional Care 2026.

items.title: Community pharmacies could offer cholesterol testing and treatment under expanding NHS pilot
items.summary: Community pharmacies could play a much bigger role in preventing cardiovascular disease by offering cholesterol testing, risk assessments and potentially prescribing treatment, a leading NHS England clinical director told delegates at CVRM Professional Care 2026.

items.title: Women with PCOS face increased cardiovascular risks as GP calls for earlier diagnosis and annual reviews
items.summary: Women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) are being diagnosed too late and need better monitoring for metabolic and cardiovascular complications, a leading women’s health specialist warned at CVRM Professional Care 2026.

items.title: Hospital admissions offer vital opportunity to improve diabetes and cardiovascular care, says expert
items.summary: Hospital admissions should be seen as a vital opportunity to address gaps in diabetes, cardiovascular, renal and metabolic care, a leading diabetologist has told delegates at CVRM Professional Care 2026.

items.title: Identifying early stage type 1 diabetes takes centre stage at CVRM Professional Care
items.summary: Testing for and managing early type 1 diabetes was the subject of a speaker session on the opening morning of CVRM Professional Care.

items.title: Cardiovascular, renal and metabolic care needs “complete re-think”, says chair of CVRM Professional Care
items.summary: Treating the person rather than individual conditions is crucial to implementing integrated cardiovascular, renal and metabolic care, delegates at CVRM Professional Care heard.

items.title: Diabetes leaders named among UK’s most influential ethnic minority figures in healthcare
items.summary: Two leading figures whose work has helped shape diabetes research, prevention and care have been recognised in a prestigious list of the UK’s most influential Black, Asian and minority ethnic people in health.

items.title: Experts warn of missed opportunities to detect kidney disease in people with diabetes
items.summary: Thousands of people living with diabetes could be missing out on early detection of chronic kidney disease because of low uptake of a simple urine test, kidney health experts have warned.

items.title: Cambridge University Hospitals awards insulin pump contract to Medtrum
items.summary: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has awarded a contract for insulin pumps and consumables to Medtrum Ltd, drawing on the NHS Supply Chain Insulin Pumps, CGM and Hybrid Closed Loop framework.

items.title: Antipsychotic diabetes risk ‘peaks in first 90 days’
items.summary: The first 90 days after being prescribed antipsychotics is the most crucial period for monitoring patients’ risk of developing diabetes, new research has suggested.

items.title: Free webinar series to support pharmacists in diabetes and obesity care
items.summary: The Diabetes & Obesity Pharmacy Alliance is launching a series of free webinars to help pharmacists navigate the evolving landscape of diabetes and obesity care, with sessions exploring injectable therapies, medicines optimisation and the complexities of patient care.

items.title: Ascensia announces strategic partnership with Sava for innovative microsensor technology
items.summary: A new wearable microsensor designed to make glucose monitoring less invasive could be available in Europe within the next two years, following a partnership between Ascensia Diabetes Care and Sava Technologies.

items.title: Study shows low energy diet combined with structured exercise reverses early onset type 2 diabetes in half of participants
items.summary: New research published in The Lancet Regional Health Americas shows that around half of people diagnosed with early-onset type 2 diabetes before the age of 45 can achieve remission through a low-energy diet combined with a structured exercise programme.

items.title: Once-weekly insulin jab for type 2 diabetes authorised by MHRA
items.summary: A new once-weekly insulin treatment for adults with type 2 diabetes has been authorised by the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA). Onswik (insulin efsitora alfa) is a long-acting basal insulin that could cut the injections needed by patients currently on daily treatment from 365 a year to 52.
